notes: Replay hard-codes 8 Control Plane revisions and 8 executor revisions (legacy, 1.0.0, v2, persistence, merged, refusal, runtime-authority, security, F5b) with one-to-one pairing logic inside _moltbot_contract (importers.py:405-433, 472-491); adding or retiring any producer revision requires editing Replay code and republishing it. This is the primary decoupling blocker.

No schema for any peer artifact (BoundedRunRecord, executor export, typed-refusal collections, journal events, W2/C8 rows) exists in this repo; the contract is encoded imperatively in importers.py/refusal_evidence.py. 30 of 68 listed rules are fully unwritten, 32 partial, 6 changelog_only (see statuses).
Replay is the single place that defines Reconstruction Bundle record_type vocabulary (schema leaves record_type a free string).

Evidence Pack re-runs Replay's import_bounded_workflow as a library (evidence importer.py:609-661) and requires byte-equal records/links/commitments/profiles/status/import_reports/semantics; therefore any Replay behavior change (e.g. new rules at 8eaf3a42, Route B record type executor_recovery_report) breaks Evidence Pack round-trips unless Evidence is updated in lockstep. Verified empirically: with Replay 8eaf3a42 on the path and Evidence 505a359, all three route_b_post_commit fixtures import in Replay but Evidence's _run_pinned_replay_validator fails with 'accepted executor observations differ from result'.

The control_plane_revision argument is caller-selected and never verified against the data (docs/reconstruction_import.md:215-218); the same string selects the decoder. Decoupling needs the producer to self-declare a profile/version in-band (the executor already does via producer_profile; the Control Plane BoundedRunRecord carries none, importers.py:727 format_version=None).

qualification/w3/producer-consumer-compatibility.json lists only 5 supported pairs while importers.py supports 4 further generations (refusal, runtime-authority, security, F5b); the matrix test (tests/test_w3_compatibility_matrix.py:22-38) therefore guards a stale subset.
